image_description: A close-up, eye-level shot of a turtle resting on rocky ground. The turtle has a dark, high-domed carapace with visible scute patterns and some lighter yellowish markings. Its head is extended, showing a pointed snout and small lateral eyes. The skin on the neck and limbs appears rough, wrinkled, and grey-brown. The front limbs are stout with visible claws and webbing. The background is a soft-focus mix of sand and rocks.
